topics.name: Right answers
topics.why: A shop shows what the API says. If a colour name, hex or family is wrong, the customer sees the wrong paint.

topics.name: Bad input
topics.why: People type codes by hand and apps send odd values. The API must say no clearly, and never crash.

topics.name: Lists and search
topics.why: Lists feed the colour pages of the web shop. A wrong count, a gap or a repeat hides paint from customers.

topics.name: Withdraw and mixable rules
topics.why: Withdrawn colours must not be sold and non-mixable products must not offer colours. These are money rules.

topics.name: Keep the promise
topics.why: The spec is a promise to every app that calls the API. Wrong error bodies, statuses or field types break those apps.

topics.name: Release gate
topics.why: Before a release we ask: can we ship? The data baseline, the sync output and the pact must still hold.
